import json
from pathlib import Path

CONFIG = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "config/defaults.json"

def limit():
    return json.loads(CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["retry_limit"]

def should_retry(status):
    return status in json.loads(CONFIG.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["retry_statuses"]
</document>

<document path="src/runner.py">
from policy import limit, should_retry

def relay(send, ack, dead_letter):
    for _ in range(limit() + 1):
        status = send()
        if status == 204:
            ack()
            return
        if not should_retry(status):
            break
    dead_letter()
</document>
